story.body: You read the five lines back and did not give any of them a name to say. You did not add a speech.

participation.context: Tried the names, heard the cart, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the king on the board comes before the names

story.body: You spoke the Verona names on the path and gave none of them a speech. A cart crossed. You allowed Tybalt as a cat's name, and then you refused to go on, because the king on the board will not wait.

relations.note: the king on the board comes before the names

title: Said the Verona names on the path

participation.context: Copied the names and the stop, and left it there.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the king still only the shape from his book

story.body: You listed the names, marked Mercutio as a cold hand and nothing else, and stopped at NOT YET. You did not write a scene or a line.
